blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Standard information retrieval metrics, such as mean Average Precision (mAP), assess performance one query at a time, based on how the similarities between a query and its positives compare against those with its negatives. The same holds for common representation learning losses, such as InfoNCE and per-query AP surrogates. None of them considers whether similarities are comparable across queries, which any system with a single decision threshold relies on. Global Average Precision ( gAP ) does, by ranking all query–candidate pairs in one list and computing a single AP. We introduce gSAP , a differentiable surrogate of gAP . It needs only a similarity matrix and a binary matrix marking the positive pairs, the same input as existing losses, so it is a drop-in replacement for them and agnostic to the encoder, the modality, and the source of supervision. Since it considers all possible pairwise comparisons in the batch jointly, it also remains trainable at low temperatures, a regime where per-query surrogates run out of gradient.
Swapping it into established recipes improves supervised metric learning, cross-modal alignment, and self-supervised pretraining, where, to our knowledge, it is the first ranking loss to replace the community standard InfoNCE in the latter two. Its similarities are more consistent across queries, which drives the gains under a universal threshold. gSAP retrieves up to four times as many positive pairs as the strongest AP surrogate at the same precision, and it degrades the least when queries with no positives in the database are added. Beyond thresholding, models trained with gSAP also learn better representations, with higher transfer, k k NN and zero-shot classification accuracy.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Average Precision (AP) ( Schütze et al., 2008 ) is the standard metric for ranking quality and is reported as mean AP (mAP) over queries across retrieval and recognition tasks ( Radenović et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2014 ; Rolínek et al., 2020 ) . mAP treats each query separately ( Figure 1 ), so the distribution of similarities may vary from query to query.
Global Average Precision ( gAP ) ( Perronnin et al., 2009 ) , in contrast, ranks all query–database pairs in a single global list and computes a single AP, i.e . it evaluates all queries jointly .
It therefore captures the consistency of similarities across queries as well as ranking quality, and bridges retrieval and detection through a threshold that separates relevant from irrelevant pairs, which is why several benchmarks adopt it ( Weyand et al., 2020 ; Ypsilantis et al., 2021 ; Douze et al., 2021 ; Pizzi et al., 2024 ; Kordopatis-Zilos et al., 2023 ) . gAP is thus the right metric for similarity models and systems operating under a single decision threshold. In Figure 1 (b), a per-query surrogate leaves positive and top-negative similarities overlapping across queries, whereas the proposed loss separates them.

blocks.en:
Despite its desirable properties, gAP is not used as a training objective, mainly because the ranking at its core is discrete and because it is computed over every pair of the similarity matrix, which is costly when the matrix is large.
In this work, we turn gAP into a practical loss for representation learning via pruning negative similarities that do not significantly impact the loss. We derive a smooth surrogate, gSAP , that directly optimizes this global metric. Per-query losses, such as the widely used InfoNCE ( Oord et al., 2018 ) and the existing AP surrogates ( Qin et al., 2010 ; Revaud et al., 2019 ; Brown et al., 2020 ; Ramzi et al., 2021 ) , optimize the ranking of each query in isolation and therefore leave the similarity scales of different queries unconstrained. gSAP ranks the whole similarity matrix at once and replaces the loss of any model whose training objective is based on a similarity matrix.
blocks.zh:
尽管它具有可取的特性,但GAP并没有被用作培训目标,主要是因为其核心的排名是离散的,而且它是在每对相似性矩阵上计算出来的,当矩阵大时成本高昂.
在这项工作中,我们把GAP变成一种实际损失,即通过推敲不会对损失产生重大影响的负面相似性来学习代表性。 我们得到一个平滑的代用,gSAP, 它直接优化了这个全球度量。 平分损失,如被广泛使用的InfoNCE(Oord等,2018年)和现有的AP代位(秦等,2010年;Revaud等,2019年;Brown等,2020年;Ramzi等,2021年),优化了每个被隔离查询的排名,因此不同查询的相似度尺度不受限制. gSAP将整个相似性矩阵一并排序,并取代任何其培训目标基于相似性矩阵的模型的丢失.

blocks.en: Ranking the whole matrix also eases the trade-off between the fidelity of the surrogate and the flow of its gradient. A small temperature makes the sigmoid follow the step function closely ( Qin et al., 2010 ; Brown et al., 2020 ) , but saturates most comparisons, so their gradients vanish ( Ramzi et al., 2021 ) . Since gSAP involves many more comparisons than per-query surrogates, as each positive is compared with every similarity in the batch rather than with its own row only, a sufficient fraction of them remains unsaturated. This allows low temperatures, and thus an accurate AP approximation, without vanishing gradients, which is not possible for the per-query counterparts.
blocks.zh: 排名整个矩阵也会使被取而代之者忠贞与其梯度流之间的取舍有所缓解. 微小的温度使得 sigmoid 紧跟步态功能(秦等,2010;布朗等,2020),但饱和度大部分比较,因此梯度消失(Ramzi等,2021). 由于gSAP涉及比每克代孕要多很多的比较,因为每克正阳性都与批次中的每一个相似性相比较,而不是仅与自己的一行相比较,所以其中足够一分之一的活性仍不饱和. 这允许低温,从而精确的AP近似,而不会消去梯度,这对每克对应物来说是不可能的.

blocks.en: The formulation needs only a similarity matrix and a binary relevance matrix, and is therefore agnostic to the encoders, the modality, and the source of supervision. Relevance marks same-class pairs in supervised metric learning, matching pairs in image–text, video–text, or audio–text alignment, and augmented views of the same sample in self-supervised learning. To our knowledge, gSAP is the first ranking loss to replace InfoNCE in CLIP-style cross-modal and self-supervised training.
blocks.zh: 该配方仅需要相似性矩阵和二进制相关性矩阵,因此对编码器,模式,监督来源不可知. 相关性在受监督的衡量学习中标出同等对子,在图像-文本、视频-文本或音频-文本对齐中标出相配对,并在自我监督的学习中放大相同样本的视角。 据我们所知,GSAP是取代InfoNCE在CLIP风格的交叉模式和自我监督训练中的第一个排名损失.

blocks.en: We evaluate gSAP by replacing only the loss in established recipes for supervised metric learning, CLIP and CLAP cross-modal alignment, MoCo v3 self-supervised pretraining, and tasks with distractor queries. Across all of them, gSAP improves gAP while remaining competitive in mAP and Recall@ k k , and outperforms InfoNCE and SigLIP, the two standard cross-modal losses, on every retrieval benchmark. It also yields better representations, as the encoders trained with it reach higher transfer, k k NN and zero-shot classification accuracy. The gains come from the consistency across queries, which translates into more matches under a single shared threshold and the smallest loss of gAP when distractor queries are added.
blocks.zh: 我们评价GSAP时,只用监督的计量学习的既定食谱、CLIP和CLAP跨模式对接、MoCo v3自我监督的预训以及以分心者查询来取代损失。 在所有这些活动中,GSAP改进了gAP,同时在mAP和Recall@kk中保持竞争力,并在每个检索基准上超越InfoNCE和SigLIP这两个标准跨模式损失。 它也产生更好的表现,因为通过它训练的编码器达到了更高的转录,k k NN和零发分级精度. 收益来自各种查询的一致性,这在单一共享阈值下转化为更多的匹配,在添加分心者查询时GAP损失最小.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are outlined below. • We advocate gAP as a metric for representation learning, since it captures both ranking quality and the consistency of similarities across queries, which per-query metrics ignore. • We propose gSAP , a smooth surrogate of gAP and a drop-in replacement for existing losses that keeps gradients alive at temperatures where per-query surrogates saturate, and negative dropping, which scales it to very large batches. • On supervised, cross-modal (image, text, video, audio), self-supervised, and distractor-query tasks, where gSAP is the first ranking loss to replace InfoNCE, it attains the best gAP on every retrieval benchmark, matches or exceeds the best per-query metrics in nearly all cases, and gains by far the most when one threshold serves all queries.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Representation learning losses differ in how much of the similarity matrix they couple. Pairwise losses score each entry on its own; the contrastive loss ( Chopra et al., 2005 ) with an absolute margin and SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) with a bias shared by all pairs impose one global threshold, but at a single operating point. Most losses act per query. Triplet ( Schroff et al., 2015 ) and Multi-Similarity ( Wang et al., 2019b ) weight pairs relative to each anchor, and proxy losses ( Deng et al., 2019 ; Kim et al., 2020 ) compare each sample with class proxies. InfoNCE ( Oord et al., 2018 ) , standard in vision–language ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and self-supervised ( Chen et al., 2021 ) learning, normalizes each row and column with a softmax; RankCLIP ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) adds listwise ordinal-consistency terms across and within modalities. Ranking surrogates directly optimize per-query AP ( Rolínek et al., 2020 ; Revaud et al., 2019 ; Brown et al., 2020 ; Ramzi et al., 2021 ) or Recall@ k k ( Patel et al., 2022 ) ; GlobalAP ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , despite its name, extends each query’s list with a memory bank and still averages AP over queries. These surrogates depend only on within-query orderings and are unchanged by any per-query increasing transformation of the similarities, and each directional InfoNCE term is unchanged by a per-query offset in its own direction. None of these terms constrains how similarities compare across queries .
Since per-query losses leave this unconstrained, comparable similarities are typically obtained with auxiliary terms ( Ramzi et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2022 ) or post hoc through per-query score normalization ( Jégou et al., 2007 ; Conneau et al., 2017 ; Pizzi et al., 2022 ) . Batch-wise ranking across groups has also been explored in object detection ( Chen et al., 2019 ) , where AP is optimized over all anchors and classes of a batch via gradient approximation. By contrast, our approach trains models by directly optimizing a single surrogate loss that ranks all samples of the batch by their similarities, with every sample acting as a query, and requires neither additional regularization nor post-hoc operations. An extended discussion of related work is provided in Appendix A .

blocks.en:
The cost of gSAP is linear in the number of pairwise similarities in the batch, and nearly all of them are negatives.
The smallest negative similarities are already well separated from the positives and barely affect gAP . Hence, to reduce computational and memory requirements in gSAP , we drop the fraction α ∈ [ 0 % , 100 % ] \alpha\in[0\%,100\%] of the smallest negative similarities. Dropping is implemented by removing these similarities, along with their corresponding labels, from the flattened similarity and label vectors used for the loss.
All positives are kept, and the optimization focuses on the negatives that still violate the ranking.
The rate α \alpha trades memory for fidelity to the full loss. Figure 2 shows its effect on the PR curve of a training batch.
Removing up to 90 % 90\% of the negatives only alters the low-precision tail of the curve, and since the loss is the area above the PR curve, a larger α \alpha simplifies the optimization and drives the loss towards zero.
In practice, large values of α \alpha cost minimal performance and under a fixed GPU memory budget they allow larger batches.

We draw the following conclusions:
(i) gSAP improves both metrics, mSAP lags behind in gAP . For τ ≤ 0.01 \tau\leq 0.01 , where the surrogate approximates its metric, mAP and gAP move together under gSAP , whereas under mSAP gAP trails mAP by a considerable margin, increasingly so as τ \tau decreases. mSAP is insensitive to the cross-query consistency that gAP depends on, so it improves gAP only as a side effect of better per-query rankings. gSAP , on the other hand, ranks the whole batch and moves both, at no cost in mAP, which is clearly above that of mSAP at three of the four temperatures.
(ii) gSAP is robust to τ \tau because its positives have more unsaturated comparisons. A small τ \tau makes the surrogate exact but saturates the sigmoid comparisons ( Qin et al., 2010 ; Brown et al., 2020 ) . Empirically, the share of unsaturated comparisons is nearly the same for both losses, about 50 % 50\% , 4 % 4\% , 0.4 % 0.4\% and 0.04 % 0.04\% at the four temperatures at initialization, roughly proportional to τ \tau , and it stays within a factor of two between the losses during training. What differs, by three orders of magnitude, is the number of comparisons per positive that enter the loss. mSAP scores each positive against the B − 2 ≈ 10 3 B-2\approx 10^{3} other similarities of its row, gSAP against the B ⁡ ( B − 1 ) ≈ 10 6 B(B-1)\approx 10^{6} similarities of the whole batch. The bottom row of the figure shows the product of the two, the average number of unsaturated comparisons per positive. At τ = 10 − 4 \tau=10^{-4} an mSAP positive has fewer than one, i.e . most positives receive no gradient, and the run stalls well below the other settings. By contrast, a gSAP positive still has more than 150 150 unsaturated comparisons, every positive keeps a gradient, and the run reaches the same mAP and gAP as at the other values of τ \tau (validated in Figure C ). This is why gSAP can operate in the regime of near-exact approximation that mSAP cannot.
(iii) At τ = 0.1 \tau=0.1 both surrogates are poor proxies of their metric. Both runs end well below the others. Gradients are plentiful, but the approximation is loose and the optimization noisy. Even in this regime, gSAP reaches slightly higher values of both metrics.
In summary, mSAP suffers more from the trade-off between an accurate approximation of the metric and the difficulty of optimizing it.

blocks.en: We study vision–language representation learning by fine-tuning the released OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) . Starting from the pretrained model, we train for 5 additional epochs on the Conceptual 12M (CC12M) ( Changpinyo et al., 2021 ) dataset using three alternative losses: (i) the original CLIP InfoNCE-based loss ( Oord et al., 2018 ) , (ii) the SigLIP sigmoid loss ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) , and (iii) our gSAP loss. We evaluate these models in zero-shot retrieval and classification. We follow the CLIP benchmark suite ( Cherti and Beaumont, 2022 ) , where applicable. Additional experiments with other vision–language models, further evaluation tasks and analyses, as well as experiments for audio–language alignment, are provided in Section B.1 .

blocks.en: Zero-shot retrieval. We evaluate bidirectional retrieval, i.e . , text → \to image/video and image/video → \to text, on three image datasets, Flickr8k ( Hodosh et al., 2013 ) , Flickr30k ( Young et al., 2014 ) , and MS COCO Captions ( Chen et al., 2015 ) ( Table 1 ), and three video datasets, ActivityNet ( Caba Heilbron et al., 2015 ) , MSR-VTT ( Xu et al., 2016 ) , and MSVD ( Chen and Dolan, 2011 ) ( Table 2 ). For image datasets, we report gAP , mAP, and Recall@5; for video datasets, we report gAP and Recall@ k k . Across all six datasets, gSAP delivers the strongest retrieval performance, with consistent gains over both InfoNCE and SigLIP in every metric and direction.

blocks.en: Zero-shot classification. We evaluate on four image datasets, ImageNet-1k ( Deng et al., 2009 ) , ImageNet-V2 ( Recht et al., 2019 ) , ImageNet-R ( Hendrycks et al., 2021a ) , and ImageNet-Sketch ( Wang et al., 2019a ) ; and three video datasets, Kinetics-400 ( Kay et al., 2017 ) , -600 ( Carreira et al., 2018 ) , and -700 ( Carreira et al., 2019 ) ( Table 3 ), using the original prompt templates for each dataset. Across all seven datasets, gSAP again provides the most consistent gains, outperforming both InfoNCE and SigLIP in every metric. Beyond these seven datasets, we also evaluate on the full suite of 40 datasets of the benchmark ( Cherti and Beaumont, 2022 ) (37 classification and 3 retrieval), spanning natural, fine-grained, satellite, medical, and synthetic imagery. Aggregating all 108 scores ( Table R ), gSAP improves on average by +0.49 over InfoNCE and +0.64 over SigLIP, indicating that the benefits of optimizing gAP also translate to improvements in recognition.

blocks.en:
In addition, we test whether the benefit survives without labels by following the MoCo v3 ( Chen et al., 2021 ) recipe and replacing InfoNCE by gSAP , with everything else unchanged. Table 4 reports top-1 accuracy of frozen backbones under linear probing (LP) and k k -nearest neighbors ( k k NN). Per-dataset results and settings are in Sections B.2 and C.2 .
Three observations follow: (i) The gain carries over to the label-free setting, where gSAP trails only on in-distribution LP at ViT-B. (ii) The gain is consistently larger under k k NN, which operates on the learned similarities directly, whereas LP fits a new linear map that can absorb a similarity scale that differs from query to query. (iii) The transfer gain is considerable and concentrated on the six fine-grained datasets ( Table H ), where hard negatives crowd the positives, which is what a single shared threshold penalizes. Furthermore, the same substitution improves music tagging in audio contrastive learning, so gSAP is not tied to a particular modality ( Section B.2 ).

此外,我们通过遵循MoCo v3(Chen等,2021年)食谱并用gSAP来取代InfoNCE, 其它一切不变, 来检验福利是否在没有标签的情况下继续存在。 表4在线性探测(LP)和克-近邻(克克NN)下报告了被冻结骨干的最高-1准确度。 每个数据集的结果和设置载于B.2和C.2节。
以下三项意见: (一)收益结转到无标签设置上,在Vit-B上,gSAP只跟踪到分配中的LP. (二)在k k NN下,收益一直较大,它直接运行在所学到的相似性上,而LP则符合新的线性映射,可以吸收一个不同查询的相似度尺度. (三)转移收益相当可观,并集中在六个精细的数据集(表H)上,硬底片会挤出正底片,这是单一共同阈值所惩罚的. 此外,同样的替代方法还改进了音频对比性学习中的音乐标记,因此gSAP不与某一特定模式挂钩(B.2节)。

Table 5 compares gSAP with pairwise (Contrastive ( Chopra et al., 2005 ) , Triplet ( Schroff et al., 2015 ) , Multi-Similarity ( Wang et al., 2019b ) ), proxy (ArcFace ( Deng et al., 2019 ) , Proxy Anchor ( Kim et al., 2020 ) ) and ranking losses (the Recall@ k k surrogate RS@ k k ( Patel et al., 2022 ) , mSAP ( Brown et al., 2020 ) ) under fine-tuning of DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) . gSAP achieves the best gAP on both datasets by a clear margin, while its mAP and R@1 remain close to the best. blocks.en: Consistency and thresholding. Consistency matters wherever one threshold has to serve every query. Table 6 shows this for the three ranking losses, with the test classes split into fitting classes, on which a threshold is selected, and evaluation classes, on which it is applied ( Section C.3 ). When each query is allowed its own optimal threshold, the three losses perform on par on both datasets, in line with mAP and R@1, since the decision is then made within each query’s ranking. With a single threshold, selected on the fitting classes and shared by all evaluation queries, gSAP outperforms both other losses on both datasets. Notably, at a precision of 0.90 0.90 , it retrieves 12 % 12\% more matches than mSAP, the second best, on SOP and 4 × 4\times as many on iNaturalist. Figure 4 indicates the reason for its effectiveness. The per-query optimal thresholds of gSAP are more concentrated around the shared one, so a single value fits more queries. The gap between F1 q and F1 g is the cost of inconsistent similarities, and gSAP reduces it without changing what happens inside each query.

blocks.en: We finally evaluate on four tasks where a large share of queries are distractor queries , i.e . queries with no relevant item in the database: copy detection (DISC21 ( Douze et al., 2021 ) ), instance-level recognition (Met ( Ypsilantis et al., 2021 ) ) and retrieval (ILIAS ( Kordopatis-Zilos et al., 2025 ) ), and animal re-identification (WildlifeReID-10k ( Adam et al., 2025 ) ). These are the settings the proposed loss targets, as they traditionally employ gAP for evaluation. The system must decide with one threshold, shared across queries, whether a match exists at all, so a distractor query is handled correctly only if its negatives fall below the positives of other queries. Per-query metrics ignore distractor queries, since a query without positives has no AP, whereas gAP considers all their negatives. Additional results and settings are in Sections B.4 and C.4 . gSAP attains the best gAP on all four tasks and the smallest drop before score normalization. The gain is mostly cross-query. On Met, mSAP and gSAP are identical without distractors and gSAP is 4.5 4.5 gAP ahead with them. SN brings the drops of all losses close together but does not close the gap between mSAP and gSAP on DISC21 for gAP , so a post-hoc correction recovers only part of what training for gAP provides. Finally, the second-best method varies across datasets and settings.
blocks.zh: 我们最终评估了大部分查询是分心查询的四个任务,即数据库中没有相关项目的查询:复制检测(DISC21(Douze等,2021年)),实例级识别(Met(Ypsilantis等,2021年))和检索(ILIS(Kordopatis-Zilos等,2025年)),以及动物重新识别(WildlifeReID-10k(Adam等,2025年)。 这些是拟议损失指标的设置,因为传统上它们使用GAP进行评价。 系统必须用一个阈值来决定,在各种查询之间共享,一个匹配是否完全存在,因此只有当一个分心者查询的负数低于其他查询的正数时,才会正确处理. Per-query 度量衡忽略了分心者查询,因为没有正数的查询没有AP,而gAP则考虑他们所有的负数. 其他成果和设置载于B.4和C.4节。 gSAP在所有四项任务上都取得了最佳GAP,在分数正常化前下降最小。 增益多为相克. 在Met上,MSAP和GSAP是完全相同的,没有分心器,GSAP领先于他们4.5 4.5 gAP. SN将所有损失的倒数拉近到一起,但并没有为gAP在DSC21上弥合mSAP和gSAP的差距,因此后热校正只回收了gAP培训提供的部分. 最后,第二好的方法因数据集和设置而异.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en: We revisit global Average Precision ( gAP ), which evaluates ranking quality together with the consistency of similarities across queries, and propose gSAP , a differentiable surrogate of it. gSAP operates on the same input as the standard losses of established training recipes, a similarity matrix and its binary relevance labels, and swapping it in, and nothing else, improves supervised metric learning, cross-modal alignment, and self-supervised pretraining, surpassing the well-established InfoNCE where it is the first ranking loss to replace it. Its similarities are more consistent across queries, which pays off whenever one threshold serves all queries. Its cost is quadratic in the batch size, which negative dropping mitigates, and part of the achievable consistency remains unrealized, leaving room for complementary approaches, e.g . learnable post-hoc score normalization ( Pizzi et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们重新检讨全球平均精度(GAP), gSAP的操作与既定培训食谱的标准损失、相似性矩阵及其二进制关联性标签相同,并互换到而不是其他方面,改进了有监督的计量学习、跨模式对接和自我监督的预训,超过了已确立的InfoNCE,因为它是取代它的第一个排名损失。 它的相似性在各种查询中更为一致,每当一个阈值为所有查询服务时,它就会得到回报。 其成本在批量规模上是四分之一,负下降可减缓,可实现的一致部分仍未实现,为补充性办法留下了空间,例如,可学习的预后分数正常化(Pizzi等,2022年)。

blocks.en: Early work employs pairwise and triplet losses, e.g . , the contrastive loss ( Chopra et al., 2005 ) and the triplet loss ( Schroff et al., 2015 ) , which pull positives together and push negatives beyond a margin. To incorporate more context, listwise ( Oh Song et al., 2016 ) and N-pair ( Sohn, 2016 ) losses sample multiple positives and negatives per anchor, and Multi-Similarity ( Wang et al., 2019b ) weights all pairs of the batch relative to each anchor. Proxy-based methods reduce complexity by learning class proxies ( Movshovitz-Attias et al., 2017 ; Teh et al., 2020 ; Kim et al., 2020 ; Zhai and Wu, 2019 ) or multiple proxies per class ( Qian et al., 2019 ) , while angular-margin losses ( Liu et al., 2017 ; Deng et al., 2019 ) enforce margin-based separation on the hypersphere. Hierarchical methods ( Ramzi et al., 2022 ; Ramzi et al., 2025 ) incorporate error severity into the ranking, while other works train with hyperbolic losses ( Ermolov et al., 2022 ; Kim et al., 2023 ) or potential fields ( Bhatnagar and Ahuja, 2025 ) . Orthogonal to the choice of loss, Metrix ( Venkataramanan et al., 2022 ) brings mixup to metric learning by interpolating both examples and target labels within a generalized formulation of these losses. All these losses sum terms defined per pair, per anchor, or per proxy, whereas gSAP couples all pairs of the batch through a single ranking.
blocks.zh: 早期工作采用对等和三重损失,例如:对比性损失(Chopra等,2005年)和三重损失(Schroff等,2015年),这些损失将正值拉到一起,并将负值推到比值之外。 要纳入更多上下文,从上下文(吴松等,2016年)和N-pair(索恩,2016年)损失样本中,每锚多为正负,多为相同性(王等,2019年b)相较于每锚,批量全部为对. 基于代用方法通过学习类代用方法(Movshovitz-Attias等,2017;Teh等,2020;Kim等,2020;Zhai和Wu等,2019)或多代用方法(Qian等,2019)来降低复杂性,而角-边用损失(Liu等,2017;Deng等,2019)则在超层上强制进行边用分. 分级方法(Ramzi等,2022;Ramzi等,2025)将误差严重性纳入分级,而其他发生双曲损失的工程列车(Ermolov等,2022;Kim等,2023)或潜在场(Bhatnagar和Ahuja等,2025. Metrix(Venkataramanan等,2022年)在选择损失时,通过将这些损失的一般表述中的例子和目标标签相插,给衡量学习带来混乱。 所有这些损失总和条款都由每对、每锚或每名代理确定,而GSAP夫妇则通过单一的排名确定所有批次的对.

blocks.en: Vision–language pretraining is commonly instantiated with CLIP-style contrastive learning ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , where image–text alignment is optimized via a softmax-normalized loss over in-batch negatives; the same loss underlies audio–language models such as CLAP ( Wu et al., 2023 ) . Recent work revisits this design by introducing new losses. RankCLIP ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) extends pairwise contrastive learning to a listwise formulation and enforces both in-modal and cross-modal ordinal ranking consistency, aiming to capture many-to-many relationships between images and texts. SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ; Tschannen et al., 2025 ) adopts a pairwise sigmoid loss that removes the need for row-wise normalization; its bias, shared by all pairs, sets one global threshold, but each pair is scored independently at that single operating point. Beyond pretraining, CPRD ( Chen et al., 2024 ) distills cross-encoder knowledge into vision–language encoders by matching the partial order of hard negatives, demonstrating that relative ranking can be more transferable than raw score regression. In this work, we target gAP directly, replacing these row-, column-, or pair-wise losses with a single AP over all image–text or audio–text pairs under a shared threshold.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言预训通常与CLIP风格的对比性学习(Radford等,2021年)相接而来,其中图像-文本的校正是通过软马克思-常态化的丢失来得到优化的;同样的损失是CLAP(Wu等,2023年)等音频-语言模型的基础. 最近的工作通过引入新的损失来重新审视这一设计. 兰克利普 (Zhang等,2025年)将双向对比学习延伸至列表式配体,并强制实施模式式和跨模式式平分排列一致性,旨在捕捉图像和文本之间的多向关系. SigLIP(Zhai等,2023;Tschannn等,2025年)采用双相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 除了预训之外,CPRD(Chen等,2024年)通过匹配硬底片的部分顺序来将交叉编码器知识分解为视觉-语言编码器,表明相对排名比原始分数回归更能被可转移. 在这部作品中,我们直接瞄准gAP,在共享阈值下,用一个单一的AP来取代这些行,列,或双向损失。

blocks.en: Contrastive self-supervised learning treats augmented views of the same sample as positives and the other samples of the batch as negatives, and optimizes InfoNCE per anchor in vision ( Chen et al., 2020 ; He et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2021 ) and audio ( Spijkervet and Burgoyne, 2021 ) . Non-contrastive methods avoid negatives altogether, either by self-distillation between a student and a momentum teacher ( Grill et al., 2020 ; Caron et al., 2021 ) or by masked image modeling, which reconstructs masked patches in pixel ( He et al., 2022 ) or token space ( Bao et al., 2022 ) . iBOT ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) combines the two by distilling masked patch tokens from the teacher, and AttMask ( Kakogeorgiou et al., 2022 ) masks the patches the teacher attends to most, making the distillation task harder. DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) and DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) scale this recipe into general-purpose backbones; DINOv3 is the starting point of our metric learning and distractor-query experiments. gSAP applies to the contrastive family: since the views define the relevance matrix, it replaces InfoNCE with no other change, whereas distillation and reconstruction losses have no similarity matrix over negatives to rank.
blocks.zh: 相矛盾的自监督学习将同为阳性样本的放大视图和批次的其他样本视为阴性,并优化了视网膜每锚的InfoNCE(Chen等,2020;He等,2020;Chen等,2021)和音频(Spijkervet和Burgoyne,2021). 非自相矛盾的方法可以完全避免负面反应,无论是通过学生与动力教师之间的自相矛盾(Grill等,2020年;Caron等,2021年),还是通过蒙面图像模型,在像素(He等,2022年)或象征空间(Bao等,2022年)中重建蒙面补丁. iBOT (周克等,2022年)通过从老师那里分取出面具补丁活符来将两者结合起来,而AttMask (Kakogeorgiou等,2022年)则将补丁遮住老师所照顾的大部分,使分取任务更加困难. DINOv2(Oquab等,2024年)和DINOv3(Siméoni等,2025年)将这种食谱规模化为通用骨干;DINOv3是我们衡量学习和分心-平分实验的起点. gSAP适用于对比性家族:由于观点定义了关联性矩阵,它以没有其他变化来取代InfoNCE,而蒸馏和重建损失没有与负数相类似的矩阵来排位.

blocks.en: To better align training with evaluation, recent work proposes differentiable surrogates for ranking metrics. Early approaches smooth NDCG ( Taylor et al., 2008 ) or learn from pairwise preferences ( Burges et al., 2005 ) . Several methods approximate AP for optimizing mAP ( Triantafillou et al., 2017 ; Rolínek et al., 2020 ; Revaud et al., 2019 ; Cakir et al., 2019 ; Brown et al., 2020 ) . BlackBox ( Rolínek et al., 2020 ) estimates gradients through sorting via black-box differentiation, while FastAP ( Cakir et al., 2019 ) improves efficiency by quantizing distances into differentiable histograms, reducing the computational cost of AP gradients. Smooth-AP ( Brown et al., 2020 ) further scales AP optimization by applying a sigmoid to similarity differences. ROADMAP ( Ramzi et al., 2021 ) replaces the sigmoid with a different function on positives and negatives, propagating only through the latter. Beyond AP, RS@ k k ( Patel et al., 2022 ) addresses the non-differentiability of Recall@ k k with a smooth surrogate. GlobalAP ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , despite its name, extends each query’s ranking with a memory bank and still averages AP over queries. Surrogates used in representation learning, however, remain query-centric and do not target global criteria such as gAP , which our loss is designed to optimize.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地使培训与评价保持一致,最近的工作为排名衡量标准提出了不同的替代标准。 早期接近平滑的NDCG(Taylor等人,2008年)或学习对等偏好(Burges等人,2005年)。 优化mAP的几种方法大致为AP(Triantafillou等,2017;Rolínek等,2020;Revaud等,2019;Cakir等,2019;Brown等,2020)。 黑色 Box (Rolínek等,2020年)通过黑匣子分拣来估算梯度,而FastAP(Cakir等,2019年)则通过将距离分解为可分辨直方图来提高效率,降低了AP梯度的计算成本. smooth-AP (Brown等, 2020.) 通过对相近性差异应用 sigmoid来进一步优化AP. ROADMAP(Ramzi等,2021年)用不同的正反相功能来取代 sigmoid,只通过后者来宣传. 在AP之外,RS@克(Patel等,2022年)用平滑的代位解决Recall@克克的无差别性. GlobalAP(Liu等,2023年)虽有名字,但将每个查询的排名以内存库来延伸,仍然平均AP比查询. 然而,在代表性学习中使用的替代物仍然以查询为中心,不针对全球标准,例如GAP,我们的损失是为了优化它。

blocks.en: Prior work aims to make similarities comparable across queries, classes, or domains, so that one threshold serves all of them; the retrieval literature calls this property cross-query calibration ( Pizzi et al., 2022 ) , which is distinct from the calibration of scores as match probabilities ( Guo et al., 2017 ) . Consistency can be encouraged during training via modified objectives that incorporate cross-example similarities ( Veit and Wilber, 2020 ) , regularizers that constrain pairwise distances within bounds ( Ramzi et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2022 ) , or dispersion losses that push nearest negatives apart ( Sablayrolles et al., 2019 ) . Beyond training time, similarity scores can be mapped post hoc to a common scale, e.g . by per-query score normalization against a background set ( Pizzi et al., 2022 ) , Platt scaling or isotonic regression ( Guo et al., 2017 ) , or learned or transductive mapping modules ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) . In contrast, gSAP needs no auxiliary regularizer or post-hoc mapping. By directly optimizing gAP , it encourages similarities that are consistent across queries as a direct effect of the loss, and adding a consistency regularizer on top brings no further gain.
blocks.zh: 先前的作品旨在让不同查询,类,或域的相似性具有可比性,这样一个阈值就能服务于所有;检索文献称这种地物跨克校正(Pizzi等,2022年),这与分数校正是匹配概率(Guo等,2017年)不同. 在培训过程中可以鼓励一致性,为此可采用具有跨实例相似性的修改目标(Veit和Wilber,2020年),在界限内限制对等距离的常态器(Ramzi等,2021年;Zhang等,2024年b;Liu等,2022年b),或将最近的负态推向分化的散射损失(Sablayrolles等,2019年)。 在训练时间之外,类似分数还可以被绘制出临时的后分数到共同的分数,例如,通过按背景设定的每克分数正常化(Pizzi等,2022年),普拉特缩放或同位素回归(Guo等,2017年),或学习或转录绘图模块(Zhang等,2024年a). 相形之下,gSAP不需要辅助正则器或后热绘图. 通过直接优化 gAP, 它鼓励在各种查询中保持一致的相似性, 作为损失的直接影响, 在顶端添加一个一致性常态化器, 没有进一步的好处。

blocks.en: The predominant evaluation is query-centric; mAP ( Zhu, 2004 ) measures the ranking of the relevant samples according to the query, and Recall@ k k ( Jegou et al., 2010 ) measures the proportion of queries for which at least one positive is ranked in the first k k positions. Other metrics are classification-based, e.g . precision, recall, F1-score ( Sivic and Zisserman, 2003 ) , and retrieval-based, e.g . normalized discounted cumulative gain (NDCG) ( Järvelin and Kekäläinen, 2002 ) , and mean reciprocal rank (MRR) ( Voorhees et al., 1999 ) . However, these metrics emphasize per-query top-rank performance and are insensitive to dataset-level retrieval quality. gAP , also reported as micro-AP ( μ \mu AP) in landmark recognition and copy detection ( Weyand et al., 2020 ; Pizzi et al., 2022 ) , instead aggregates all positive and negative pairs across queries to produce a single global precision–recall curve, effectively casting retrieval as a detection problem under a shared similarity threshold. We therefore adopt gAP as a primary metric and derive a surrogate loss to optimize it directly.
blocks.zh: 主要评价以查询为中心;mAP(Zhu,2004年)根据查询衡量相关样本的排名;Recall@kk(Jegou等,2010年)衡量在第一个kk职位中至少有一个正数的查询比例. 其他衡量标准以分类为基础,例如精确度、召回率、F1-分数(Sivic和Zisserman,2003年)和取回率(NDCG)(Järvelin和Kekäläinen,2002年),以及平均对等等级(MRR)(Voorhees等,1999年)。 然而,这些度量衡强调每克顶级性能,对数据集级检索质量不敏感. gAP,在标志性识别和复制检测(Weyand等人,2020年;Pizzi等人,2022年)中也报告为微AP(μ\mu AP),相反,将所有正对和负对在查询之间汇总,生成一个单一的全局精度-召回曲线,在共享相似性阈值下将检索有效铸作检测问题. 因此,我们采用GAP作为主要衡量标准,并得出替代物损失,直接加以优化。

blocks.en: We assess whether the benefits of optimizing gAP extend beyond vision by repeating the protocol in the audio–language domain. We initialize LAION-CLAP ( Wu et al., 2023 ) with an HTS-AT ( Chen et al., 2022 ) base audio encoder that is pretrained on music, speech, and AudioSet ( Gemmeke et al., 2017 ) and fine-tune for 10 epochs on AudioCaps ( Kim et al., 2019 ) with the same three losses as in the main paper. Table A reports zero-shot audio–text retrieval on the Clotho ( Drossos et al., 2020 ) validation and evaluation splits, together with zero-shot classification on ESC-50 ( Piczak, 2015 ) and UrbanSound8K ( Salamon et al., 2014 ) . gSAP outperforms both CLIP and SigLIP on every column, with a clear margin in text-to-audio retrieval on the Clotho evaluation split, while SigLIP falls below the pretrained model on ESC-50.
blocks.zh: 我们通过重复音频语言领域的协议来评估优化GAP的好处是否超越了愿景。 我们初始化了LAION-CLAP(Wu等,2023年),并配有一款HTS-AT(Chen等,2022年)基础音频编码器,对音乐,语音,AudioSet(Gemmeke等,2017年)进行预训,并对音频Caps(Kim等,2019年)上的10个纪元进行了微调,损失与主报相同. 页:1 一篇关于克洛托(德罗索斯等,2020年)验证和评价的零镜头音频-文本检索报告,以及ESC-50(皮克扎克,2015年)和UrbanSound8K(萨拉蒙等,2014年)的零镜头分类. gSAP在每个列上都优于CLIP和SigLIP,在克洛托评价分拆上的文本到音频检索中有明显的比值,而SigLIP则低于ESC-50上的预训模型.

blocks.en: We extend the vision–language results of Section 4 with the same fine-tuning protocol. We first analyze the effect of batch size and of negative dropping with OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32, then repeat the zero-shot retrieval and classification evaluations starting from two other models, OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/16 and LAION-400M ( Schuhmann et al., 2021 ) CLIP ViT-B/32, and finally evaluate on an additional task, zero-shot composed image retrieval. gSAP is the best of the three losses in every setting.

blocks.en: Batch size sensitivity. We fine-tune OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 on CC12M for 5 epochs with varying batch sizes and compare InfoNCE and SigLIP with gSAP on zero-shot image–text retrieval on Flickr8k, Flickr30k, and MS COCO ( Figure A ). gSAP achieves the highest gAP on all three datasets at every batch size, with the largest margin at the smallest batch. At 512, it already exceeds InfoNCE trained with a four times larger batch on Flickr30k and MS COCO, so its gain does not rely on large batches.

blocks.en: Zero-shot retrieval. Tables C and D repeat the image and video retrieval evaluation starting from OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/16 and LAION-400M CLIP ViT-B/32. The ViT-B/32 trends hold: for both models, gSAP is the best or tied-best objective in every metric and direction on every dataset. With ViT-B/16, it doubles the gAP of the pretrained model on MS COCO. The LAION-400M model is harder to improve by fine-tuning on CC12M. gAP drops for InfoNCE on Flickr8k and MS COCO, and both InfoNCE and SigLIP degrade on ActivityNet and MSR-VTT, whereas gSAP improves gAP on all six datasets and is the only loss that improves every image retrieval metric. MSR-VTT is the hardest case. With ViT-B/16, InfoNCE and SigLIP fall below the pretrained model in gAP and video → \to text R@1, whereas gSAP improves both, outperforming SigLIP by 3.3 3.3 R@1. With LAION-400M, no loss recovers the pretrained video → \to text recall, but gSAP loses the least.

blocks.en: Zero-shot composed image retrieval. Table E reports results on ConCon-Chi ( Rosasco et al., 2024 ) , an instance-level composed image retrieval (CIR) benchmark where each query pairs a reference image of a specific object with a text modifier describing the target scene. Following the standard zero-shot CIR protocol, the retrieval score is the product of the image-to-image and text-to-image cosine similarities. All three losses improve over the pretrained model, and gSAP is best in every metric with both backbones; SigLIP stays close with ViT-B/32, but the gap widens with ViT-B/16.

blocks.en: B.3 Metric learning
blocks.zh: B.3 计量学习

blocks.en: We further evaluate the methods in a scarce data regime controlled by two parameters: γ \gamma , the percentage of training classes, and ρ \rho , the number of samples per class. Evaluation settings are described in Section C.3 . Figure B reports the performance of gSAP compared with the other two ranking surrogates (mSAP and RS@ k k ) under different settings. gSAP is consistently the best in terms of gAP , with the largest margins at ρ = 2 \rho{=}2 , reaching up to 6 gAP over the second-best method. When training with a small γ \gamma , gSAP often surpasses competitors trained with more than twice the data. We attribute this to its formulation over all pairwise similarities, whereas competing losses operate row-wise and observe a single positive per row in this setting. Similarly, for ρ = 4 \rho{=}4 , gSAP remains the best, and trained models generally surpass the pretrained model, reflecting the benefit of additional annotations and multiple positives per row. The bottom row of the figure shows the mAP results, where all three losses perform similarly, achieving nearly identical mAP scores, in line with the results from the main paper. The pretrained model already has good mAP.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估由以下两个参数控制的稀缺数据系统中的方法: γ\gamma, 培训课的百分比, 和\rho, 每班样本的数量。 评价设置见C.3节。 图B报告gSAP在不同的设置下与其他两个排名代词(MSAP和RS@kk)相比的性能. gSAP在gAP方面始终是最佳的,最大边距为: ^ = 2\rho{=}2, 超过第二最佳方法达到6 gAP. 在使用一个小的 γ\gamma 进行训练时, gSAP 往往会超过接受训练的竞争对手,其数据超过两倍以上。 我们将此归因于它在所有对等相似性上的表述,而相竞损失则按行进行,并在这种情况下每行观察到一个正数。 同样,对于 $ = 4\rho{=}4, gSAP 仍然是最佳的,经过训练的模型一般都超过预先训练的模型,反映了每行附加说明和多个正数的好处. 图中下行显示的是mAP结果,这三种损失都表现类似,按照主论文的结果,实现几乎完全相同的mAP分数. 预训模型已经具备了良好的mAP.

blocks.en: Figure C presents the gAP performance of the model trained with gSAP under different settings. Performance is very low for large τ \tau values greater than 0.1; however, it peaks and plateaus as τ \tau decreases below 0.01. Additionally, we assess the impact of the drop rate α \alpha on the batch size and, consequently, on performance. It is evident that the larger the batch size that fits in memory, which is determined by the drop rate, the better the performance.
blocks.zh: 图C显示在不同环境下通过GSAP培训的模型的GAP性能. 对大于0.1的大型\tau值来说,性能非常低;然而,由于\tau值下降到0.01以下,峰值和高地的性能非常低。 此外,我们还评估了α-α下降率对批量规模以及因此对性能的影响。 显然,适合内存的批量尺寸越大,由下降率决定,性能越好.

blocks.en: We add two regularizers proposed to constrain the similarity scale, TCM ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) and KoLeo ( Sablayrolles et al., 2019 ) , as auxiliary losses to each ranking loss ( Table L ). TCM helps in general the per-query losses and brings them closer to gSAP , but not consistently, e.g . performance of mSAP on SOP drops. Also, it adds nothing on top of gSAP , while KoLeo hurts gAP everywhere. TCM constrains the similarity scale across queries, which gSAP already achieves through its loss alone, whereas KoLeo spreads the embeddings apart and does not target this consistency. An explicit regularizer thus recovers part of what gSAP provides, at the price of extra hyper-parameters, and without consistent effectiveness.
blocks.zh: 我们新增了两个拟限制相似度尺度的常态器,TCM(张等,2024b)和KoLeo(Sablayroles等,2019),作为每个排名损失的辅助损失(表L). TCM有助于一般的每克损失,使其更接近GSAP,但并非始终如一,例如MSAP在SOP滴滴上的表现. 在GSAP上, TCM限制各种查询的相似性尺度,GSAP仅通过丢失就已经实现,而KoLeo则将嵌入分出,不针对这种一致性. 因此,一个明确的调节器可以以额外超参数的价格回收部分GSAP提供的东西,而且没有一贯的效力。

blocks.en: Table L replaces the default smooth approximation ( Brown et al., 2020 ) with SoftBin ( Revaud et al., 2019 ) , BlackBox ( Rolínek et al., 2020 ) and ROADMAP ( Ramzi et al., 2021 ) , each implemented both as an mAP and as a gAP surrogate, with its own hyper-parameters tuned based on the values recommended in the original work. Whatever the approximation, the gAP surrogate beats its mAP counterpart in gAP by a clear margin at similar mAP and R@1. The gain therefore comes from ranking the whole similarity matrix at once, not from the particular AP approximation.
blocks.zh: 表L将默认平滑近似值(Brown等人,2020年)替换为SoftBin (Revaud等人,2019年), Black Box(Rolínek等,2020年)和ROADMAP(Ramzi等,2021年),各自作为mAP和gAP代位器执行,它们自己的超参数根据原作所推荐的数值调取. 不管近似值如何,GAP代用在相近的mAP和R@1上以一个明确的比值来比取其在gAP中的mAP对应. 因此,收益来自同时对整体相似性矩阵进行排序,而不是来自特定的AP近似.

blocks.en: Table M: Negative dropping and batch size. gAP , mAP, and R@1 of gSAP on SOP for different drop rates α \alpha , the fraction of the lowest negative similarities dropped during training. A higher drop rate allows a larger batch size on the same GPU, which improves gAP .
blocks.zh: 表M:负下降和批量大小。 gAP, mAP, 和R@1, 对不同下降率的 SOP, α\ alpha, 最低负相的一小部分在训练中下降. 更高的下降率允许在同一个GPU上更大的批量大小,这改善了gAP.

blocks.en: Table M analyzes the effect of negative dropping by varying the drop percentage α \alpha . Performance remains remarkably stable even when discarding a large fraction of negatives. In particular, removing up to 99.9 % 99.9\% of negatives, reducing their number by three orders of magnitude, has only a marginal impact. Performance degrades only when the remaining negatives become extremely few, suggesting that a minimal number is still necessary for effective training. Increasing the batch size while keeping α = 99 % \alpha=99\% improves gAP , showing that the proposed loss benefits from additional pairwise interactions even when most easy negatives are discarded.

blocks.en: Vision–language. We follow the standard CLIP benchmark suite ( Cherti and Beaumont, 2022 ) , covering both cross-modal retrieval and zero-shot recognition across a broad range of domains. For zero-shot retrieval, we evaluate on three image datasets, Flickr8k ( Hodosh et al., 2013 ) , Flickr30k ( Young et al., 2014 ) , and MS COCO Captions ( Chen et al., 2015 ) , and three video datasets, ActivityNet ( Caba Heilbron et al., 2015 ) , MSR-VTT ( Xu et al., 2016 ) , and MSVD ( Chen and Dolan, 2011 ) ( Table 2 ). For zero-shot classification, the benchmark includes generic object and scene recognition datasets such as ImageNet-1k ( Deng et al., 2009 ) and its OOD variants ImageNet-V2 ( Recht et al., 2019 ) , ImageNet-Sketch ( Wang et al., 2019a ) , ImageNet-A and ImageNet-O ( Hendrycks et al., 2021b ) , and ImageNet-R ( Hendrycks et al., 2021a ) ; Caltech101 ( Fei-Fei et al., 2004 ) ; CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) ; SUN397 ( Xiao et al., 2010 ) ; STL10 ( Coates et al., 2011 ) ; DTD ( Cimpoi et al., 2014 ) ; FGVC Aircraft ( Maji et al., 2013 ) ; Flowers-102 ( Nilsback and Zisserman, 2008 ) ; Oxford-IIIT Pets ( Parkhi et al., 2012 ) ; Stanford Cars ( Krause et al., 2013 ) ; GTSRB ( Stallkamp et al., 2011 ) ; SVHN ( Netzer et al., 2011 ) ; VOC2007 ( Everingham et al., 2010 ) (single- and multi-label); and FER2013 ( Goodfellow et al., 2013 ) . It further includes robustness, bias, and geographic benchmarks such as ObjectNet ( Barbu et al., 2019 ) and Country211 ( OpenAI, 2021 ) ; remote-sensing datasets such as EuroSAT ( Helber et al., 2019 ) and RESISC45 ( Cheng et al., 2017 ) ; medical datasets such as Diabetic Retinopathy ( Kaggle and EyePACS, 2015 ) and PatchCamelyon ( Veeling et al., 2018 ) ; and synthetic or structured reasoning benchmarks such as CLEVR ( Johnson et al., 2017 ) , dSprites ( Matthey et al., 2017 ) , DeepMind Lab ( Beattie et al., 2016 ) , SmallNORB ( LeCun et al., 2004 ) , KITTI distance ( Geiger et al., 2012 ) , MNIST ( LeCun et al., 1998 ) , and Rendered SST2 ( Socher et al., 2013 ; Radford et al., 2021 ) . For benchmarks derived from a common source dataset, such as ImageNet-A/O/R/Sketch or the different attribute splits of CLEVR, dSprites, and SmallNORB, we use the standard task definitions from the CLIP benchmark. Additionally, we evaluate zero-shot classification on three video datasets, Kinetics-400 ( Kay et al., 2017 ) , -600 ( Carreira et al., 2018 ) , and -700 ( Carreira et al., 2019 ) . Audio–language. We fine-tune on the AudioCaps ( Kim et al., 2019 ) training split (45,178 audio–caption pairs) and evaluate zero-shot on datasets not used for fine-tuning: audio–text retrieval on the Clotho ( Drossos et al., 2020 ) validation (1,045 clips) and evaluation split (1,045 clips), and classification on ESC-50 ( Piczak, 2015 ) (2,000 clips, 50 classes) and UrbanSound8K ( Salamon et al., 2014 ) (8,732 clips, 10 classes).

blocks.en: Vision–language. All experiments are implemented in OpenCLIP ( Ilharco et al., 2021 ; Cherti et al., 2023 ) 2 2 2 https://github.com/mlfoundations/open_clip . Our main experiments fine-tune the released OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 checkpoint ( Radford et al., 2021 ) ; in the appendix we additionally fine-tune the OpenAI ViT-B/16 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and the OpenCLIP ViT-B/32 trained on LAION-400M ( Schuhmann et al., 2021 ; Cherti et al., 2023 ) . Fine-tuning is conducted on CC12M ( Changpinyo et al., 2021 ) (10.97M image–text pairs, one pass per epoch without resampling), for 5 epochs with learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} , 2,000 warm-up steps followed by cosine decay, on 2 H200 GPUs (141 GB each). The global batch size is 1,792 for ViT-B/16 and 2,304 for ViT-B/32. We adopt the default OpenCLIP optimization setup: AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with weight decay 0.2, ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.98 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.98) and ϵ = 10 − 6 \epsilon=10^{-6} , fp16 automatic mixed precision, no gradient clipping, and no gradient accumulation, with the default OpenCLIP image preprocessing at 224 × 224 224\times 224 . Both image and text encoders are updated jointly, without tower freezing, locking, or architectural changes, and we evaluate the final checkpoint without checkpoint selection. We compare three losses: the original CLIP InfoNCE loss ( Oord et al., 2018 ; Radford et al., 2021 ) , the SigLIP sigmoid loss ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) , and our gSAP loss. In all three, the logit scale is learnable and initialized from the pretrained checkpoint ( t = 100 t=100 ); for SigLIP, the learnable bias is initialized to 0 0 , since CLIP checkpoints do not provide one. For gSAP , we apply our differentiable surrogate to the same gathered, scaled similarity matrix, with τ = 10 − 3 \tau=10^{-3} and no negative dropping unless stated otherwise. Audio–language. We fine-tune the released LAION-CLAP ( Wu et al., 2023 ) 3 3 3 https://github.com/LAION-AI/CLAP checkpoint, which pairs an HTS-AT base audio encoder ( Chen et al., 2022 ) with a RoBERTa text encoder ( Liu et al., 2019 ) and is pretrained on music, speech, and AudioSet ( Gemmeke et al., 2017 ) . Both towers are fine-tuned jointly for 10 epochs. Audio is resampled to 48 kHz and cropped or zero-padded to 10 s, without feature fusion. We use AdamW with learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} , weight decay 0.2, ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.98 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.98) , and ϵ = 10 − 6 \epsilon=10^{-6} , 60 warm-up steps followed by cosine decay, gradient clipping at 1.0, bf16 mixed precision, and a global batch size of 1,024. The logit scale is learnable and initialized to 1 / 0.07 1/0.07 ; for SigLIP, the bias is initialized to − 10 -10 . Both domains. In all cases, we use distributed gathering so that the loss is computed from similarities over all samples in the global batch. Reported numbers are the mean over three seeds.

blocks.en: Vision–language. Image benchmarks follow the CLIP benchmark ( Cherti and Beaumont, 2022 ) 4 4 4 https://github.com/LAION-AI/CLIP_benchmark with its default class names and prompt templates. For video, we encode a single frame per video: the frame at 3 s for MSR-VTT, MSVD, and Kinetics, and the temporal midpoint for the much longer ActivityNet videos. Kinetics class embeddings average four action prompts (“a photo of a person {}.”, “a video of a person {}.”, “a photo of people {}.”, “a video of {}.”). We use the full MSR-VTT test split (2,990 videos, 59,800 captions), the 436 available MSVD test videos (18,098 captions), and paragraph-to-video retrieval on ActivityNet val_1, where each of the 1,063 available videos is paired with the concatenation of its captions. Kinetics-400, -600, and -700 are evaluated on their validation sets (19,881, 29,739, and 33,966 clips; 400, 599, and 700 classes). For retrieval we report gAP, i.e., average precision over the flattened query–item similarity matrix, together with Recall@ k k ; for classification, top-1/top-5 accuracy and mean per-class recall. Audio–language. For retrieval, each Clotho clip is paired with its first reference caption, and we report R@1 in both directions against the full gallery. For classification, class embeddings average four prompts (“the sound of {}”, “a sound of {}”, “an audio recording of {}”, “{} sounds”), and we report accuracy over all clips of each dataset.

blocks.en: C.2 Self-supervised learning
blocks.zh: C.2 自我监督的学习

blocks.en: Pretraining uses ImageNet-1k ( Deng et al., 2009 ) without labels. In-distribution accuracy is measured on the ImageNet-1k validation set; distribution shift on ImageNet-V2 ( Recht et al., 2019 ) , ImageNet-R ( Hendrycks et al., 2021a ) and ImageNet-Sketch ( Wang et al., 2019a ) , reported as their mean; corruption robustness on ImageNet-C ( Hendrycks and Dietterich, 2019 ) , 15 corruptions at 5 severities. Transfer uses ten datasets: six fine-grained ones—FGVC Aircraft ( Maji et al., 2013 ) , CUB-200 ( Wah et al., 2011 ) , Stanford Cars ( Krause et al., 2013 ) , Oxford-IIIT Pets ( Parkhi et al., 2012 ) , Flowers-102 ( Nilsback and Zisserman, 2008 ) and Food-101 ( Bossard et al., 2014 ) —and four coarse-grained object, scene and texture sets—CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) , DTD ( Cimpoi et al., 2014 ) and SUN397 ( Xiao et al., 2010 ) .
blocks.zh: Pretrain使用ImageNet-1k(Deng等,2009年)无标签. 在ImageNet-1k验证集上测得分发精度;ImageNet-V2上的分发转移(Recht等,2019)., Image Net-R (Hendrycks等, 2021a)和ImageNet-Sketch (Wang等, 2019a.),被报道为"中";"ImageNet-C"(Hendrycks和Dietrich, 2019.)上腐败强烈,有15起腐败以5分之分. 转让使用10个数据集:6个精细的数据集 -- FGVC飞机(Maji等,2013年),CUB-200 (Wah等,2011年),斯坦福汽车(Krause等,2013年),牛津-IIIT Pets (Parkhi等,2012年),花卉-102 (Nilsback and Zisserman,2008年)和Food-101 (Bossard等,2014年)——和四个粗糙的物体、场景和纹理集——CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100(Krizzevsky,2009年),DTD (Cimpoi等,2014年)和SUN397 (Xiao等,2010年).

blocks.en: We take the MoCo v3 ( Chen et al., 2021 ) recipe unchanged 5 5 5 https://github.com/facebookresearch/moco-v3 . We train a ViT-S/16 and a ViT-B/16 on ImageNet-1k for 300 epochs with batch size 4,096 and learning rate 4 ⋅ 10 − 3 4\cdot 10^{-3} . We replace the InfoNCE loss by gSAP computed over the same gathered query–key similarity matrix, with the positives on the diagonal and temperature τ = 0.2 \tau=0.2 . Nothing else changes: augmentations, momentum encoder, projection and prediction heads, optimizer and schedule are those of the official code. The baselines are the released 300-epoch MoCo v3 checkpoints with their published linear heads. Re-training the official recipe reproduces them to within seed variance.
blocks.zh: 我们采用MoCo v3(Chen等,2021年)食谱不变 5 5 5 https://github.com/facebookresearch/moco-v3. 我们在ImageNet-1k上训练一个Vit-S/16和一个Vit-B/16,供300个世纪使用,批量尺寸为4,096个,学习率为4-X-10-3 4\cdot 10-Q-3}。 我们用同一收集的查询 - 密钥相似度矩阵的gSAP 来取代 InfoNCE 损失, 并用对角和温度的正数 = 0.2\tau=0.2 。 没有其他变化:增强,动力编码器,投影和预测头,优化器和时间表都是官方代码的. 基线是公布的300个MoCo v3检查站, 重新训练官方食谱 复制到种子差异。

blocks.en: All numbers are top-1 accuracy on frozen features. Linear probing (LP) on ImageNet-1k, its OOD variants and ImageNet-C uses the official 90-epoch linear head on the CLS features of the frozen backbone (the published MoCo v3 heads for the baselines and heads trained with the identical recipe for gSAP ). Every OOD set is classified with the ImageNet-1k head and no dataset-specific training. ImageNet-R covers 200 classes and the softmax is restricted to them. Transfer datasets have no published head, so LP there follows prior work ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ; Ericsson et al., 2021 ) : a linear classifier per dataset on frozen features, with the learning rate and weight decay chosen on a held-out split and the classifier refit on train and validation. Mean of three seeds is reported, with seed standard deviation ≤ 0.11 \leq 0.11 on every set. k k -Nearest Neighbors ( k k NN) is a weighted vote over the k = 20 k{=}20 nearest training features, with k k fixed and not tuned (cosine similarity, weights exp ⁡ ( s / 0.07 ) \exp(s/0.07) ) on the full 1.28M-image ImageNet-1k train set, or on each transfer set’s own training split. Neither the choice of k k nor of the linear head affects any comparison: k = 20 k{=}20 is within 0.15 0.15 of every model’s best k ∈ { 5 , … , 200 } k\in\{5,\dots,200\} with the same model ranking at every k k , and the official head is 0.2 0.2 – 0.7 0.7 points above a short probe on the same features, again with an identical ranking.
blocks.zh: 所有数字在被冻结的特性上都是最精确的 在ImageNet-1k上的线性探测(LP),它的OOD变体和ImageNet-C在被冻结的主干线的CLS特征上使用正式的90-epoc线性头(已公布的MoCo v3头用于基线并用相同的食谱被训练的头用于gSAP. 每个OOD集与ImageNet-1k头被分类,没有针对数据集的培训. ImageNet-R覆盖了200个类,软马克斯被限制在其中. 传输数据集没有被公布的头部,因此LP有之前的工作(Kornblith等,2019;Ericsson等,2021):每组被冻结特性的数据集一个线性分级器,在被搁置的分级上选择学习率和重量衰减,在列车和验证上进行分级器重置. 报告为三种种子的平均值,每套种子标准差为0.11\leq0.11。 kk-Nearest nearbors (kk NN) 是对 k = 20 k{=}20 相距最近的训练特性进行加权投票,其中 kk 固定而不调用(cosine相近,权重 exp ⁡ (s/ 0.07)\exp (s/ 0.07)) 完全 1.28M-image ImageNet-1k列车组,或每个调用组自己的训练分. kk的选择和线头的选择都不影响任何比较: k = 20 k{=}20在0.15分以内,是每个型号最佳的 k { { 5,., 200 } k\in 5,\dots 200 \} 在每 k k 的同名型号排名中,官方头是 0.2 – 0.7分以上对同名特征的短探,同样排名相同.

blocks.en: For audio we follow CLMR ( Spijkervet and Burgoyne, 2021 ) unchanged 6 6 6 https://github.com/Spijkervet/CLMR : a SampleCNN encoder ( Lee et al., 2017 ) is pretrained on the raw waveforms of MagnaTagATune ( Law et al., 2009 ) with the augmentation chain, batch size, optimizer and schedule of the official code. We replace InfoNCE by gSAP on the same similarity matrix between the two augmented views of a batch, with temperature τ = 0.05 \tau=0.05 , and keep every other setting of the InfoNCE run. Evaluation is linear probing on the frozen encoder for the 50 tags of MagnaTagATune, scored by ROC-AUC and PR-AUC. We pretrain three seeds per loss, each with its own probe, and report the mean.
blocks.zh: 对于音频,我们遵循CMR(Spijkervet和Burgoyne,2021年)不变的6 6 6 https://github.com/Spijkervet/CLMR:一个标本CNN编码器(Lee等,2017年)在MagnaTagatune(Law等,2009年)的原始波形上进行预训,并配有增强链,批量大小,优化器和正式代码的排行. 我们用一个批次的两个放大视图的相同相似度矩阵替换 InfoNCE, 温度 \\ tau=0.05, 并保持 InfoNCE 的所有其他设置运行 。 评估是线性地对被ROC-AUC和PR-AUC打分的"MagnaTagATune"50个标记被冻结的编码器进行检测. 我们每损失3个种子, 每一个种子都有自己的探测器, 并报告这个平均值。

blocks.en: C.3 Metric learning
blocks.zh: C.3 计量学习

blocks.en: We conduct experiments on two widely used datasets: Stanford Online Products (SOP) ( Oh Song et al., 2016 ) and iNaturalist ( Van Horn et al., 2018 ) . We follow the dataset split used in prior work ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Patel et al., 2022 ) . SOP consists of products. The training split has 59,551 images from 11,318 classes, and the test split contains 60,502 images from 11,316 classes. iNaturalist consists of natural images of wildlife and plants. The training split has 325,846 images across 5,690 classes, while the test split contains 136,093 images across 2,452 classes. For SOP, all test images serve as queries. Due to the large size of the iNaturalist test set, for mAP and gAP computation, we sample 4 images per test class as queries, resulting in 9,808 queries.
blocks.zh: 我们对两个广泛使用的数据集进行实验: 斯坦福在线产品(SOP)(Oh Song等,2016年)和iNaturalist(Van Horn等,2018年). 我们遵循先前工作中所用的数据集划分(Brown等人,2020年;Patel等人,2022年)。 SOP由产品组成. 训练分会由11,318个班的59,551个图像组成,测试分会由11,316个班的60,502个图像组成. iNaturalist由野生动物和植物的自然图像组成. 训练分会拥有325,846个图像,分布于5,690个班,而测试分会包含136,093个图像,分布于2,452个班. 对于SOP,所有测试图像都用作查询. 由于iNaturalist测试集的大小较大,为mAP和gAP计算,我们每个测试类抽取了4个图像作为查询,结果产生了9,808个查询.

blocks.en: For all runs, we tune hyper-parameters with Optuna ( Akiba et al., 2019 ) , optimizing gAP . Tuning on a different metric, i.e . mAP, yields the same results in several verification runs. Specifically, we split the training set into 70% for training and 30% for validation and run 10 trials to search for the learning rate η ∈ [ 10 − 5 , 5 ⋅ 10 − 4 ] \eta\in[10^{-5},5\cdot 10^{-4}] and the temperature τ ∈ [ 10 − 4 , 5 ⋅ 10 − 2 ] \tau\in[10^{-4},5\cdot 10^{-2}] . For the other metric learning losses, we tune their main hyper-parameter and keep the rest fixed to the recommended settings of the original papers, and for the regularizers of Table L we also tune their weight. After tuning, the final model is trained with the selected hyper-parameters on the whole training set and evaluated on the test set. The full process, tuning, training and evaluation, is run for three random seeds.
blocks.zh: 所有运行,我们与Optuna(Akiba等,2019年)调制高参数,优化了gAP. 采用不同的衡量标准,即mAP,在几次核查中得出同样的结果。 具体来说,我们把培训分为70%,30%用于培训,并进行10次试验,以寻找学习率。 对于其他的度量学习损失, 我们调用他们的主要超参数 并保持其余的固定到 原论文推荐的设置, 对于表L的正则器 我们调用他们的分量。 调试后,最终型号会用整个训练集上选定的超参数进行训练,并在试验集上进行评估. 全部过程,调试,训练和评价,为三个随机种子运行.

blocks.en: For the comparison of metric learning losses, we use the ViT-S/16 variant of the DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) vision encoders. Our implementation is in PyTorch ( Paszke et al., 2019 ) and builds on the open-source repository of Recall@ k k 7 7 7 https://github.com/yashvarpatel/RecallatK_surrogate . Unless specified otherwise, we use a batch size of 1,000 and a chunk size of 200 for the multi-stage backpropagation of Revaud et al. (2019) ; Patel et al. (2022) . We train for 100 epochs with the AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) optimizer and fix the embedding dimension d d to 512 in all experiments. For the comparison with the state of the art, we experiment with ResNet50 ( He et al., 2016 ) and ViT-B/16 ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) , trained for 200 epochs following the implementation details of Patel et al. (2022) . Experiments are conducted on Nvidia A100 and H200 GPUs with 40 GB and 141 GB of memory, respectively. Each run is executed on a single GPU.
blocks.zh: 为了比较测量学习损失,我们使用了DINOv3(Siméoni等,2025年)视觉编码器的Vit-S/16变体. 我们的实施在PyTorch(Paszke等,2019年),并以开源存储器Recall@kk 7 7 7 https://github.com/yashvarpatel/RecallatK_surrogete为基础。 除非另有说明,我们使用1000个分批量和200个分批量来进行Revaud等人(2019年);Patel等人(2022年)。 我们用"亚当W"(Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019)进行100个时代的训练,优化所有实验中的嵌入维度d至512. 为了与最新技术进行比较,我们进行了ResNet50(He等,2016年)和Vit-B/16(Dosovitskiy等,2021年)的实验,根据Patel等的落实细节(2022年),为200个时代进行了培训. 在Nvidia A100和H200 GPU上分别用40GB和141GB的内存进行实验. 每个运行在一个单一的GPU上执行.

blocks.en: For Table 6 and Figure 4 , the test classes are split in half, identically for every model, into fitting classes, used only to select a threshold, and evaluation classes, on which it is applied. The evaluation queries are the test images of the evaluation classes, and the gallery is the whole test split minus the query. On the fitting classes we select one threshold for maximal F1 and one as the lowest threshold with precision 0.90 0.90 . F1 g is the mean F1 of the evaluation queries at the first, and R@P90 the recall over all evaluation pairs at the second. F1 q uses the F1-optimal threshold of each evaluation query instead. Thresholds are searched with a step of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} .

blocks.en: C.4 Tasks with distractor queries
blocks.zh: 第C.4节 有分心者查询的任务

blocks.en: DISC21 ( Douze et al., 2021 ) is an image copy detection benchmark: queries are edited copies of reference images, and the query set is dominated by distractor queries that have no source in the reference set. The Met dataset ( Ypsilantis et al., 2021 ) is instance-level recognition of artworks, where a query is either a photograph of an exhibit in the database or a distractor photograph of no exhibit. ILIAS ( Kordopatis-Zilos et al., 2025 ) is instance-level image retrieval at scale, retrieving images of particular object instances from a database dominated by distractor images. WildlifeReID-10k ( Adam et al., 2025 ) is re-identification of individual animals across many species. Each task keeps the training and evaluation code of its official repository, with only the loss replaced.
blocks.zh: DISC21(Douze等,2021年)是一个图像复制检测基准:查询由参考图像的编辑复制而来,而查询集则以在参考集中没有来源的分心查询为主. Met数据集(Ypsilantis等,2021年)是对艺术品的举例识别,其中查询要么是数据库中展览的照片,要么是没有展览的分散视线照片。 ILIAS(Kordopatis-Zilos等,2025年)是规模化的实例级图像检索,从一个以分心器图像为主的数据库中取回特定物体的图像. 野生生物ReID-10k(Adam等,2025年)是多物种个体动物的重新识别. 每次任务都保留其官方储存库的培训和评价代码,只有损失被替换.

blocks.en: Unless tuned on the validation split of a task, gSAP uses τ = 0.001 \tau=0.001 and negative dropping with α = 90 % \alpha=90\% , and every task trains with batches of 4,096 4{,}096 samples. All tuned hyper-parameters are selected by grid search. InfoNCE and mSAP are trained with exactly the same recipes and their hyper-parameters are tuned in the same way. All results are averaged over three random seeds. On DISC21 we follow the SSCD repository 8 8 8 https://github.com/facebookresearch/sscd-copy-detection and fine-tune a DINOv3 ViT-B/16 at 224 224 px for 30 30 epochs with AdamW. The absolute learning rate, the temperature τ \tau and the weight λ \lambda of the entropy regularizer of SSCD are tuned on the dev queries. On Met we follow the official repository 9 9 9 https://github.com/nikosips/met and fine-tune a DINOv3 ViT-B/16 at 512 512 px for 10 10 epochs with AdamW, one warm-up epoch and cosine decay. The learning rate and the temperature τ \tau are tuned on the validation set, as are the k k and the temperature of the k k NN classifier, in accordance with the original work. On ILIAS we follow the official repository 10 10 10 https://github.com/ilias-vrg/ilias and train a linear adaptation layer on UnED ( Ypsilantis et al., 2023 ) , on top of publicly available extracted features. We report PE-L@336 ( Bolya et al., 2025 ) for the main comparison as it achieves the best performance. We follow the default training settings from the original work, with the only difference that we draw four samples per class in every batch. The DINOv3-L and SigLIP2-L@512 runs of Table Q use exactly the same protocol. On WildlifeReID-10k we follow the WildlifeDatasets toolkit ( Čermák et al., 2024 ) 11 11 11 https://github.com/WildlifeDatasets/wildlife-tools and fine-tune a DINOv3 ViT-B/16 at 224 224 px for 100 100 epochs with AdamW, learning rate 5 ⋅ 10 − 5 5\cdot 10^{-5} and 10 10 warm-up epochs, again with four samples per class in every batch. Score normalization (SN) ( Pizzi et al., 2022 ) reduces every similarity of a query by β \beta times the mean similarity of the query to its k k nearest neighbors in a background database. On DISC21 we use the setting of the original work, β = 1 \beta=1 and k = 3 k=3 with the DISC21 training set as background, and on ILIAS β = 0.4 \beta=0.4 and k = 1 k=1 with UnED as background.
blocks.zh: 除非调用一个任务的验证分拆,gSAP使用 \\\ tau=0.001 并用 α = 90%\ alpha= 90 = 负下降,每个任务列车的分批量为 4,096 4{,}096个样本. 所有调制的超参数通过网格搜索选择. blocks.en: Ordering the blocks. The blocks of a query must keep their order, so the task is to interleave M M chains of blocks, and we use the ratio rule of Sidney (1975) for it. Along each chain, consecutive blocks are merged into segments until the density is non-increasing along the chain, and the segments of all queries are then ordered by decreasing density, ties kept in chain order. The merging step is the pool-adjacent-violators algorithm ( Provost and Fawcett, 2001 ; Fawcett and Niculescu-Mizil, 2007 ) , and the ordering step is the probability ranking principle ( Robertson, 1977 ) applied to all pairs jointly.

The rule gives one, and a second is built greedily, without merging, by appending at each step the densest of the blocks that come next in their chains.
